services.name: Sunset Dolphin Tour
services.desc: A Perfect Way to End the Day! Rates Adult (Ages 12+): $43 Child (Ages 3-11): $38 Infant (Ages 2 & under): $5 Duration 1 Hour and 30 Minutes The Tour View amazing sunsets on the water aboard the Scarlet Lady™! Watch in awe as wild dolphins frolic and play in the light of the setting sun out on the Lydia Ann Channel. A photographer’s dream the Sunset Tour will give you once in a lifetime opportunities to witness the beauty of Port Aransas backed by a setting sun. Don’t forget to get a snap shot of the iconic Lydia Ann Lighthouse at sunset, it will sure to make a photograph that you will be showing off to friends and family for years! services.desc: Specialty Cruise! Rates Person: $58 (All Ages) Duration 2 Hours The Tour This is one of the newest tours Port Aransas has to offer. This tour will cruise down the ship channel towards the Port of Ingleside. There is live narration describing the area along the way to the port. Once at the port the narrator talk about the rigs and platforms that are in port for repairs. We will be able to give as much information as the different companies supply us with. The tour is a total of 2 hours and then once you return to the docks lunch will be served. The tour includes lunch with water or tea. Gratuities for the restaurant staff are not included. services.desc: Book your private charter on the Scarlet Lady today and experience the perfect setting for holiday parties, team building, and relaxation. Whether you’re planning a small group outing with family or friends, celebrating a bachelor/bachelorette party, or organizing a corporate retreat, we have you covered. The Scarlet Lady™ is a catamaran-style vessel, that comfortably accommodates up to 48 passengers and cruises smoothly through the waters of the Lydia Ann Channel, ensuring a comfortable ride without motion sickness.
